Intracerebral visual acuity is the ability of the brain to recognize and visualize what it sees.

It is a training to see the image by the parallel method and the cross method of 3D stereogram. It is a training to train the ciliary muscles by randomly following images with different sizes, shapes, colors, and numbers.
